svg.title: Personal Agents OS: architecture overview
svg.desc: The owner talks to a team of AI agents (roles). Agents read optional sources and the knowledge graph, and write every fact back to markdown in git first. Tools enforce the graph's shape. The Life App and Obsidian are views for humans.
svg.text: Memory first, markdown first: every fact lands in plain markdown in git before anything else uses it.
· the point of view of the whole graph
the only frontmatter reader and writer
--fix writes every reverse edge; done at mechanical: 0
the gap register: what the memory knows it doesn't know
one human = one node, placeholder slug to real name
Your whole life on one screen
Life Health: one score over seven areas
phone home screen and desktop layout
point a vault at the folder: the graph view runs on it
runner memory is mirrored to the repo the same turn
one fact, one .md file, frontmatter links
tokens and keys live outside the repo
Roles ship without names; personas are generated on your machine.
